coverage_summary: Global daily scan covered infrastructure, energy and logistics, regulation and capital access, production and technology deployment, resources, labour, trade and institutions. The most material fresh mechanism was Saudi Arabia's expanded use of Ras Tanura-to-Sohar ship-to-ship crude logistics while the East-West pipeline remains impaired; this is operational adaptation to a current conflict disruption, but evidence available today does not yet establish a durable structural-state change relative to the canonical Atlas. Other surfaced items were announcements, pilots or insufficiently evidenced to change an Atlas condition, accessibility, confidence, catalyst or transition path. No candidate promoted.
